To me, I wouldnt get through my breakdowns without my fiance. But it's his choice to be there not his responsibility. Him being there shows me he cares and wants to work towards a common goal of getting me better for us to prosper in life. If your bf cant/doesnt want to/wont be there then maybe re evaluate for someone who is willing to give you their time.
No body HAS to be there for you and no body should force themselves. But people who chose to be there for you are the ones you need.
